done:
Setup Viewer (SPEC 8.10) is finished: a read-only page for metadata.CarSetup, built on the previous agent's uncommitted work.
- 170 settings are grouped into Aero, Brakes, Suspension, Alignment, Tyres, Diff, Gearing, Electronics and Engine, plus Other for unknown keys (empty on all three samples).
- Per-wheel settings sit in a 2x2 FL FR / RL RR group with a step-range track. The display is stringValue, plus a range track where min<max.
- The header shows the car, Symmetric, "27 of 170 adjustable in this session" (only where the session locks settings) and "5 with a recorded change" (only where the file records one). Four headline figures lead: brake bias, rear wing, tyre compound, TC.
- A pinned toolbar holds search (Ctrl/Cmd+F, Esc clears), Show N/A and Adjustable only toggles, a shown-of-total counter and one chip per section. The chip for the section under the bar lights up as you scroll.
- Sections fold with a size animation. Hover and focus states are in place and reduced motion is honoured.
- The gearing section has a shift diagram (rpm against speed, one line per gear) and a table of top speed, upshift rpm, rpm after the shift and the drop.
- Loading skeleton, no-setup, unreadable-setup and no-match states are all stated, with a way out.
- Fixed today: chips could not scroll to sections far down the page (lazy list); a dead band in the toolbar; chips overflowing at 1000 px (now icon-less and mouse-draggable); an AnimatedSize assertion under reduced motion; pill overflow under fallback fonts; ungrammatical footer and no-match copy; Ctrl+F needed a focus first.

data_findings:
All measured on the three samples (Practice/Qualify/Race); the JSON re-queried today.
- 172 top-level keys in every file, same keys and order: 110 VM_*, 60 WM_*-W_{FL,FR,RL,RR}, gearGraph, symmetric. That is 170 settings per file (510 total).
- value is a step index: minValue is 0 in all 510. stringValue is the game's rendering of that step.
- lastSavedStringValue is the rendering of the lowest step. It equals stringValue on 127/125/125 settings and value==0 on 121/117/122. It is not the saved setup.
- available=false is only for slots the car lacks: the gear slots past numForwardGears, and the per-gear upshift-rpm slots.
- N/A (stringValue "N/A") is 58/38/54 settings per sample. available alone under-reports it: 159/160/159 are available.
- isFreeSetting is 170/170/27 (Race). Of the 27, 5 read N/A, so 22 are shown by default.
- numChangesValue is non-zero on 5 of 510, all in Qualify: VM_VIRTUAL_ENERGY -74 and the four tyre compounds at -1.
- diffComparisonValue is 0 in all 510. symmetric is true in all three.
- gearGraph holds kiloRPM (10 pairs: peak rpm, rpm after the upshift, first pair zero), topSpeed (10 entries, zero padded), numForwardGears (6/7/6) and unit "kph".
- Spa gearGraph re-checked: peak 8.5k rpm in every gear, and gear 1→2 drops to 6.568k (top speeds 119.6 and 154.7 kph give 6.57k).
- Fixed-setup Race locks springs, dampers, camber, toe, wing and pressures (143 settings).
- Cross-checks against telemetry, carried over from the previous agent's unit tests and not re-run today:
  - VM_BRAKE_BALANCE is front:rear, e.g. 51.2:48.8 against a Brake Bias Rear event of 0.4875.
  - TC and ABS maps equal the TCLevel and ABSLevel events (5/7/6 and 9/0/9).
  - VM_VIRTUAL_ENERGY.value equals the first Virtual Energy sample (100/26/47).
  - The litres in VM_FUEL_CAPACITY's string equal the first Fuel Level sample (86.0/20.8/40.9 L).
  - WM_BRAKEDISC is disc thickness in cm, matching the first Brake Thickness sample.
spec_notes:
§8.10 "Built in v0.11": The Setup Viewer is a read-only page over `metadata.CarSetup`, parsed in `features/setup_viewer/application/car_setup.dart` as pure Dart, with the provider built on `sessionMetadataProvider` (no SQL of its own). The three samples share one 172-key blob (110 `VM_*`, 60 per-wheel `WM_<NAME>-W_<CORNER>`, `gearGraph`, `symmetric`), so the work is reading it, not discovering a schema. Settings group into Aero, Brakes, Suspension, Alignment, Tyres, Diff, Gearing, Electronics and Engine, with unknown keys kept under Other (empty on all samples). Keys are humanised from an explicit catalogue, and the game's `caption` is shown as a second line in sentence case. Per-wheel settings render FL FR over RL RR; the corner comes from the key (`-W_FL`), so this is safe and unrelated to telemetry's value1..4 (resolved separately in 15.5). The row shows `stringValue`, a range track over the step index, and quiet markers. The page is one pinned toolbar (search with Ctrl/Cmd+F and Esc, Show N/A, Adjustable only, a shown-of-total count, one chip per section that scrolls to and opens its section and lights as the page scrolls) above collapsible section cards. All sections are laid out eagerly, not lazily, so a chip can reach a section thousands of pixels down. The chips drop their icons below a 1040 px interior and accept mouse drag, so all nine fit at 1000 px. `gearGraph` renders as a shift diagram plus a table (top speed, upshift rpm, rpm after shift, drop), with "—" for the top gear. Every charted number is also in the table. Empty (no CarSetup), unreadable and no-match states are stated with a way out. Motion runs through AppDurations/AppCurves and is skipped under reduced motion. Tests: 44 unit tests on the real JSON of all three samples, 30 widget tests with real fonts loaded, and 5 goldens (`setup_viewer_golden_test.dart`).

§14 roadmap entry, findings from building the Setup Viewer (all checked on the three samples):
- `value` is a step index (minValue 0 in all 510 settings), not a physical quantity. `stringValue` is the game's rendering of the step. A step is 0.1 deg of camber, 0.25 points of brake bias and 0.1 cm of Spa ride height, and it is the same constant across corners set at different indices.
- `lastSavedStringValue` is NOT the saved setup: it is the rendering of the lowest step (`-5.00 deg`, `0 (Off)`, `57.0:43.0`), equal to `stringValue` wherever value is 0. A "changed since saved" marker built on it would be wrong, so none is drawn. Only a non-zero `numChangesValue` (5 of 510, all Qualify: virtual energy -74, four compounds -1) is shown, as "Δ n". Zero is not shown as "unchanged", because its reference is not in the data.
- `available` means "this car has no such slot" (the gear slots past numForwardGears, and the per-gear upshift-rpm slots). It under-reports N/A: 58/38/54 settings read N/A, from 11/10/11 unavailable plus settings that are available but read "N/A" (chassis-adjust slots, pit-stop slots). N/A is therefore `!available || stringValue=="N/A"`.
- `isFreeSetting` is "adjustable in this session": 170/170 in Practice and Qualify, 27 in the fixed-setup Race (5 of them N/A, so 22 shown). Marked only where it distinguishes.
- `diffComparisonValue` is 0 in all 510. `symmetric` is true in all three, with every left/right pair identical. The false case is untested.
- `gearGraph`: kiloRPM holds 10 (peak, after-upshift) pairs with the first pair zero, and topSpeed holds 10 entries with zero padding. Peak is the rev limit (Spa 8.5k in every gear). Gear-1→2 drop checks out (8.5k × 119.6/154.7 ≈ 6.57k against 6.568k). Nominal top speeds sit a few percent under what the car actually ran, so they are labelled nominal.
- Cross-checks against telemetry, from the unit tests and not re-run today: brake-bias string against the Brake Bias Rear event, TC/ABS maps against TCLevel/ABSLevel, VM_VIRTUAL_ENERGY.value against the first Virtual Energy sample, VM_FUEL_CAPACITY's litres against the first Fuel Level sample (so it reads as fuel loaded), WM_BRAKEDISC as disc thickness in cm.
- Build-time lessons: (1) a lazy SliverList silently breaks scroll-to for sections not yet built, so eager layout is used (170 rows is cheap). (2) `AnimatedSize(duration: Duration.zero)` asserts in Flutter 3.47 ("mutated in its own performLayout"), so reduced-motion paths must skip it entirely. (3) Widget tests measuring widths need the real fonts loaded; the Ahem fallback inflates them. `loadAppFonts()` in the setup-viewer harness is reusable.
